title: N5 · Unit 7

lesson.title: Family photos
lesson.description: Talk about family, where people live and work, and what they look like.
lesson.canDo: Talk about your family and ask politely about someone else's

grammar.title: ています: ongoing states
grammar.explanation: て-form + います describes an ongoing action or a lasting state: 住んでいます (lives), 働いています (works), 結婚しています (is married). Place of living takes に; place of work takes で.
grammar.example: 姉は東京に住んでいます。
grammar.translation: My older sister lives in Tokyo.

grammar.title: My family, your family
grammar.explanation: When you talk about your family to people outside it, use the plain words (父, 母, 兄, 姉); for someone else's family use the polite ones (お父さん, お母さん, お兄さん, お姉さん, ご家族). This is the safe beginner convention for polite conversation. Inside the family, and in casual talk, people often say お母さん for their own mother too.
grammar.example: お母さんはお元気ですか。

dialogue.title: A photo on the counter
dialogue.scene: Yui notices a photo you've put down on the bookshop counter.

lines.speaker: Yui
lines.line: これはご{家族|かぞく}の{写真|しゃしん}ですか。
lines.romaji: Kore wa gokazoku no shashin desu ka.
lines.meaning: Is this a photo of your family?

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: はい。{父|ちち}と{母|はは}と{姉|あね}です。
lines.romaji: Hai. Chichi to haha to ane desu.
lines.meaning: Yes. My father, my mother and my older sister.

lines.speaker: Yui
lines.line: お{姉|ねえ}さんは{髪|かみ}が{長|なが}いですね。
lines.romaji: Onēsan wa kami ga nagai desu ne.

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: はい。{姉|あね}は{東京|とうきょう}に{住|す}んでいます。{会社|かいしゃ}で{働|はたら}いています。
lines.romaji: Hai. Ane wa Tōkyō ni sunde imasu. Kaisha de hataraite imasu.
lines.meaning: Yes. She lives in Tokyo. She works at a company.

lines.speaker: Yui
lines.line: そうですか。ご{両親|りょうしん}は？

lines.speaker: You
lines.line: ハノイに{住|す}んでいます。

exercises.prompt: Where does your older sister live?
exercises.explain: 姉は東京に住んでいます.

exercises.context: Say where your sister lives now.
exercises.line: {姉|あね}は{東京|とうきょう}に{住|す}んで＿＿。
exercises.explain: 住む → 住んで + います for where someone lives.

exercises.line: {会社|かいしゃ}＿＿{働|はたら}いています。
exercises.explain: Working is an action, so the place takes で. Living takes に.
ご両親は？ → ハノイに住んでいます.

exercises.context: You want to ask Yui how her mother is.
options: {母|はは}は{元気|げんき}ですか。
お{母|かあ}さんはお{元気|げんき}ですか。
お{母|かあ}さんは{元気|げんき}だ？
exercises.explain: Someone else's mother is お母さん, and お元気 is polite. 母 is only your own.

exercises.context: Your sister works at a company.
exercises.line: お{姉|ねえ}さんは{何|なに}をしていますか。
options: {会社|かいしゃ}で{働|はたら}いています。
お{姉|ねえ}さんは{会社|かいしゃ}です。
exercises.explain: In this conversation, about family and jobs, 何をしていますか asks what she does for a living. The same words can also mean 'what is she doing right now?'
Place of living + に + 住んでいます.
髪が長いですね: long hair.
